description: Get the curated superinvestor directory — a hand-picked list of well-known value investors and fund managers (Buffett, Ackman, Burry, Klarman and more), each with their 13F filer CIK and latest reported portfolio value, position count, quarter-over-quarter change, and report date. Portfolio value covers long US-listed 13F positions only, not total firm AUM; as-of dates vary by filer, and rows lagging the group's latest quarter are marked (stale). Use the returned CIK with GetInstitutionPortfolio for a manager's full holdings, or GetInstitutionQuarterlyActivity for their latest buys and sells.
name: GetSuperInvestors
title: Superinvestor Directory
